title: SB Energy Postpones IPO to December or 2027
summary:
The builder of computing infrastructure for OpenAI has updated its schedule for a stock market debut. SB Energy is now targeting a listing in December or potentially in 2027, marking a shift from the September timeline the firm had planned during the summer. The SoftBank-controlled entity focuses on data center development to support artificial intelligence workloads.

The company is currently constructing a massive data center in Ohio for OpenAI as terms for its public offering shift. Other ventures in the AI space, such as Anthropic, have seen an increase in investor attention as the timing for the SoftBank unit's entry into the public market slides.
